# windows_dns_client (Data Source)

Reads the observed DNS client settings of one network interface on a remote Windows host without managing them.

`ipv4_server_addresses` / `ipv6_server_addresses` report the statically configured servers (automatic families report `[]`); `effective_ipv4` / `effective_ipv6` are DHCP-inclusive and report the live servers.

Returns an error when no interface matches the alias.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Read-only lookup of one interface's DNS client settings.
data "windows_dns_client" "secondary" {
  interface_alias = "Ethernet 2"
}

output "dns_static_ipv4" {
  value       = data.windows_dns_client.secondary.ipv4_server_addresses
  description = "Statically configured IPv4 DNS servers ([] when the family is automatic)."
}

output "dns_effective_ipv4" {
  value       = data.windows_dns_client.secondary.effective_ipv4
  description = "Live IPv4 DNS servers (static plus DHCP-provided)."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface_alias` (String) Network interface alias on the target host. Matched exactly and case-insensitively, never as a wildcard.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `connection_specific_suffix` (String) Connection-specific DNS suffix, as observed on the host (`""` when unset).
- `effective_ipv4` (List of String) Live IPv4 DNS servers, as observed on the host (static plus DHCP-provided).
- `effective_ipv6` (List of String) Live IPv6 DNS servers, as observed on the host (static plus DHCP-provided).
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: the canonical (trimmed) interface alias.
- `interface_guid` (String) Interface GUID (braces included), as observed on the host.
- `interface_index` (Number) Numeric interface index, as observed on the host.
- `ipv4_server_addresses` (List of String) Static IPv4 DNS servers in order, as observed on the host (`[]` when the family is automatic).
- `ipv6_server_addresses` (List of String) Static IPv6 DNS servers in order, as observed on the host (`[]` when the family is automatic).
- `register_this_connection_address` (Boolean) Whether this connection's address is registered in DNS, as observed on the host.
- `use_suffix_when_registering` (Boolean) Whether the connection-specific suffix is used when registering in DNS, as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
